revision: v13 (Fusion 360: MotorMount_v13 SLEEVE mount — revolved cup OD31 x bore Ø25.5 on wheel-axis s'=14..50 enclosing the motor to the gearbox region; cap wall s'=14..18.6 carries Ø8 nose hole + PCD17 Ø3.5 through-holes + Ø7.2x3.5 washer pockets + Ø18.4 counterbore seat s'=18.3 for motor front boss; FRAME fastening = width-direction top tabs (y=±24, z=141..147) with 2x Ø4.5 vertical holes at (62,±19.5) matching Frame_L1 Ø4.5 holes -> M4 bolt+nut sandwich; single-body integrated cup+web+tab, 39 analytic faces, no fillets/protrusions; motors rebuilt as per-station baked components FIT0521_P0/P1/P2 at identity transform; WheelAdapter_v4 tube extended to s'=11.5 for 3.7 mm shaft engagement; lambda=33; plan-B inward)

face_count.mount_v13_face_types: 解析面のみ(自由曲面・不要凹凸なし)。キャップ+ウェブ+タブ一体の単一ソリッド

arrangement: plan-B inward: motor inserted into Ø25.5 bore of the sleeve (radial clearance 0.25 mm vs Ø25 can) from the inner open end s'~50; motor front boss seated on cap seat s'=18.3 via Ø18.4 counterbore, face planes s'=18.5..18.7; M3 bolts + washers inserted from wheel-side Ø7.2 pockets through cap-wall Ø3.5 holes into PCD17 gearbox taps; Ø4.2 output shaft on axis into WheelAdapter_v4 bore Ø4.2 (adapter tube spans s'=-1.0..+11.5, shaft tip s'=7.8 -> 3.7 mm engagement); motor tail passes through Ø48 clearance hole in Frame_L1

wheel_geometry.motor_axis_alignment: motor shaft axis = -u33 (dot = 1.0000, all 3 stations); motor geometry baked into per-station comps FIT0521_P0/P1/P2 (identity occurrence transform -> immune to transform rollback)

overlap_mm3.note: TemporaryBRepManager intersection (booleanOperation op=1) on occurrence-space proxy bodies; all pairs 0 mm3 at all 3 stations after sleeve redesign. Mount occurrences: MotorMount_v13 x3

hole_alignment.gearbox_taps: motor front face M3 taps at PCD17 (±8.5,0)/(0,±8.5) local; verified coaxial with sleeve cap-wall holes
hole_alignment.cap_holes: 4x Ø3.5 through the cap wall (s'=14..18.6 solid), coaxial with PCD17 tap pattern
hole_alignment.washer_pockets: 4x Ø7.2 x ~3.5 mm on wheel-side cap face
hole_alignment.nose_hole: Ø8 central clearance on axle axis
hole_alignment.counterbore: Ø18.4 counterbore s'=15..18.4 inside cap for motor front boss (Ø17.6 x s'~18.5..21.5 penetration)
hole_alignment.tab_holes_vs_frame: 2x Ø4.5 vertical holes through width-direction tabs at (62,±19.5) mm match Frame_L1 Ø4.5 holes (3 stations); tab top z=147 flush with L1 bottom, M4 bolt+nut sandwich
hole_alignment.frame_L1_tail_holes: 3x Ø48 clearance holes for motor tails

clearance_mm.note: ball_to_motor は車軸線と球心の最近接距離(74 mm)から球半径50+モータ半径12.2を引いた解析値。ボア径Ø25.5はØ25胴体に対し半径0.25 mmの隙間

printability.orientation: スリーブ軸は車軸方向(水平から57°)。y法線側面をベッド伏せでスリーブ軸は水平、外筒下面オーバーハングはウェブが支える; あるいはタブ下面ベッド伏せ。サポート要否はスライサー確認
printability.integrated: キャップ+ウェブ+タブ単一ソリッド、面数39、不要凹凸なし
printability.hole_orientation: キャップ Ø8/Ø3.5/Ø7.2 はスリーブ軸方向、タブ Ø4.5 は垂直穴
printability.material_note: Fusion 上は鋼材質(仮置き)。実印刷は ABS/PETG/PLA 想定; ballbotParameters.m は rhoABS=1050 で体積換算済み

envelope_mm.note: モーターが内側に格納されたため外形はフレーム径支配

mass_properties.note: Fusion 360 physicalProperties 計測値(オカレンス実配置基準)。mount_v13 の主慣性は平行軸定理でCG基準へ換算した推定値(暫定: CG系テンソル直接出力はAPI未取得)。ballbotParameters.m へ ABS 密度換算で反映済み

frame_L1.type: M4 bolt + nut sandwich (frame plate + mount tab clamped together)
frame_L1.mount_tab_holes: 2x Ø4.5 vertical through width-direction tabs (y=±24, z=141..147) at (62,±19.5) mm, tab top flush with Frame_L1 bottom; nut access on exposed tab underside
frame_L1.frame_holes: 6x Ø4.5 vertical in Frame_L1 plate at station-rotated positions of (62,±19.5) mm

gearbox_face.type: M3 bolts + washers through sleeve cap-wall Ø3.5 holes into PCD17 gearbox taps — sole motor retention; wheel-side Ø7.2 pockets seat heads+washers
gearbox_face.cap_holes: 4x Ø3.5, coaxial with PCD17 tap pattern (measured)

fasteners.clamp_strap: DELETED — sleeve bore constrains can radially; axial retention by face bolts only

assumptions: タブ上面(z=147)は Frame_L1 下面に面一で接し、タブの Ø4.5 穴とフレームの同位置穴を通す M4 ボルト+ナットで挟み締結
モーターはスリーブ開口(s'~50)から挿入し、前面ボスを Ø18.4 カウンターボア座面(s'=18.3)へ収容。ホイール側キャップのワッシャーポケットから M3 ボルト+ワッシャーでギヤボックス前面タップへ締結
モーター尾部とエンコーダ配線は Frame_L1 の Ø48 クリアランス穴を通過
ギアボックス前面タップの実寸(径・有効深さ)は実機採寸で確定する
ホイールの軸方向位置は実機ハブの Dカット止めネジで確定(アダプタ側に追加の軸位置決め構造は無し)
旧マウント(スラブ式)のオカレンスは削除済み。現行は MotorMount_v13 のみ
CAD干渉ゼロは実作業性(モーター挿入、ナット締結、工具アクセス)を保証しない — 実印刷で確認
